class: Any test fixture that types a broker tradingsymbol (or a symbol/expiry pair) from memory instead of taking it from the real instrument catalogue can pass for months while encoding a contract Zerodha does not list; the defect surfaces only when some later code checks the catalogue, and every test built on the fixture then has to change.
mechanism: W-023's partial-execution fixtures used NIFTY26OCT<strike>CE/PE symbols with the weekly 2026-10-06 expiry; the real catalogue slice lists that expiry as NIFTY26O06<strike>.. (NIFTY26OCT.. is the monthly 2026-10-27 format, e.g. NIFTY26OCTFUT). Nothing checked the catalogue until W-026's send-time sink did.

first_seen.evidence: builder: catalogue check refused NIFTY26OCT… for expiry 2026-10-06; real symbols NIFTY26O06…; fixture fixed; verifier confirmed no assertion weakened

fix: W-026 switched the execution fixtures to catalogue symbols. Sweep 2026-09-29 (grep NIFTY26OCT|SENSEX26OCT in tests/): 20 uses in 14 files remain (tests/orders x5 files, tests/engine x3, tests/scenario x2, tests/execution x3, plus the fixture CSV's real NIFTY26OCTFUT); not yet checked against the catalogue; deferred issue filed.

detection.note: Guarded when a test asserts every tradingsymbol literal in tests/ resolves in tests/fixtures/instruments/instruments_slice.csv with the expiry it is paired with.
